lines.speaker: Mr. Blob
lines.text: Ohhh, you're stuck already? How unfortunate…

lines.speaker: Mr. Blob
lines.text: Sometimes you just need to dig a little deeper...

lines.speaker: Oris
lines.text: I don't get it. Can you explain it better?

lines.speaker: Mr. Blob
lines.text: You really don't like using your brain that much, huh? Have you ever dug something up? I assume yes. Did you not need a tool for that...?

lines.speaker: Oris
lines.text: Oh, you're right. I must find something like a shovel!
